english.note: This is the all-purpose term for someone who advocates preserving natural environments or historic landmarks.

examples.english: The preservationist strongly supports preserving old villages and opposes building high-rises.
examples.traditional: 保育人士好支持保留舊村落，唔贊成起高樓。
